Achieve professional skin rejuvenation with the Dr Pen Ultima M8S Wireless Microneedling Pen, featuring a 0.25mm needle length and 22 replacement needle cartridges for varied skin treatments.

Designed to promote collagen production and improve skin texture, this wireless device offers six adjustable speeds and a bright LED digital display for precise control. Ideal for reducing fine lines, acne scars, and stretch marks while enhancing overall skin tone.

Key Features

  • Wireless Design: Portable and easy to use without cords for convenient treatments.
  • Adjustable Speeds: Six-speed settings allow customization for different skin types and treatment areas.
  • 22 Needle Cartridges: Includes 22 high-quality needles with a precise 0.25mm length for safe and effective microneedling.
  • Secure 3-Lock Connector: Ensures the needle cartridge locks firmly for stability during use.
  • Durable Build: Made with a sturdy silver ABS plastic body for long-lasting performance.

Specifications

  • Needle Length: 0.25mm / 0.01in
  • Number of Needle Cartridges: 22 pcs
  • Speed Settings: 1–6 adjustable levels
  • Body Material: ABS Plastic, Silver colour
  • Dimensions (Pen): Approx. 15cm / 5.9in length
  • Weight (Pen): Approx. 85g / 3oz

Package Includes

  • 1 × Dr Pen Ultima M8S Wireless Microneedling Pen
  • 22 × Microneedling Needle Cartridges (0.25mm)
  • 1 × Protective Storage Case
